title: Häme Castle

terrainReference.basis: Unmodified terrain reference at the inner castle grounds; contact at each mapped building is sampled locally.

mapIdentity.provider: OpenStreetMap Hämeen linna castle relation and exterior parts
mapIdentity.scope: Named OSM multipolygon relation 15882655 and its mapped open courtyard, seven other building and wall roles as listed in the native footprint bundle, and the OSM-mapped perimeter of the 1559 cannon tower. Roof zones subdivide the intact building plans.

note: The exact original behind the published Qualla lake view and the independently cleared south view show the fieldstone plinth, brick keep, twin square hipped towers, lower brick outbuildings, and round stone cannon tower beneath a shallow pyramidal roof. The conservation report supplies the separate perimeter and bakery building identities and their construction history.
